# Castle Reikguard

> **Headquarters Grand Order Reiksguard** + **bolthole Imperial family** depuis Gorbad Ironclaw 1707 IC. Résidence Prince Héritier Wolfgang Holswig-Abenauer. **Runic anti-magic** : Casting Tests -3 SL inside walls. Scène S59 audience Wolfgang + 3 Yeux résidents (Kathe + Per + Ingrid).

## Identité
- **Type** : **Fortified castle** sur promontoire 200ft above Reiker Marshes, confluence Teufel + Reik.
- **Fonction** : **Headquarters Grand Order of the Reiksguard** (elite secular order défendant Reikland + Imperial bloodline).
- **Histoire canon (ch.4 l.67-77)** : Bolthole Imperial family post-Gorbad Ironclaw invasion 1707 IC. **Heavily refortified** post-Gorbad withdrawal — **Dwarf runic devices** repel magic.
- **Apparence canon** : *« strikes building, tall + imposing, built above Reik on steep cliff side. Pennants Reiksguard heraldry + coat of arms Emperor's family fluttering. Intricate Dwarf runes carved into stonework »*.
- **Tags** : `#CastleReikguard` `#Reiksguard` `#Reikland` `#Wolfgang` `#9Yeux` `#KatheRuttmann` `#PerHaldestaake` `#IngridRademakers` `#AntiMagic` `#Dwarf` `#Arc7` `#S59` `#Ch4` `#Altdorf`

## Source
- **EiR ch.4 l.66-77** *Castle Reikguard* description complète.
- **EiR ch.4 l.81-83** : *« Within the walls of Castle Reikguard, all Language (Magick) and Channelling Tests suffer a penalty of -3 SL. Those made to cast spells from the lores of Witchcraft, Necromancy, Daemonology, and all Chaos magic suffer a penalty of -6 SL. It is considered highly impolitic to cast a spell here »*.
- **EiR ch.4 l.272-303** *Rooms of the Tutors* — 9 Eyes rooms (3 occupants Reikguard).

## Géographie

- **Promontoire** : keep + flanking towers >200ft above Reiker Marshes.
- **Confluence Teufel + Reik** : strategic river position.
- **Curtain wall** : surrounding complex + lesser towers.
- **Main gatehouse** : south overlooking broad plain (cleared trees, impossible approche unseen).
- **Inner buildings** : training grounds + barracks + armouries + facilités relaxation + observance religieuse.

## Restrictions

- **Casting Tests -3 SL** : *« any Sail Tests made to control the balloon are made with a penalty of -3 SL »* — appliqué Channelling+Language Magick.
- **Lores Witchcraft + Necromancy + Daemonology + Chaos** : -6 SL.
- **Spell casting socially impolitic**.

## Zones ch.4

### East Wing — Neuf Yeux private quarters (canon ch.4 l.272)
- Corridor 9 doorways + brass signs (Vigilant Eye, Fractured Eye, etc.).
- Locks : 10 SL extended Hard (-20) Pick Lock. Forcing : 17 SL extended Difficult (-10) Strength.

### North Wing — guest accommodation
- **Spartan** : where PJ stay if remain ch.4 l.208.

### Throne Chamber Wolfgang
- Receive PJ. **Open door policy advisors**.

## Investigations ch.4

### Exploring Castle Table (canon ch.4 l.235)
- d100 :
  - 01-50 Nothing.
  - 51-61 Just the Place! (related place clue : bookshelf/study).
  - 62-66 A Clue! (scuff marks + parchment hint).
  - 67-00 Footsteps! (junior servant / senior servant / patrolling knight / pair knights / Neuf Yeux resident / Prince Héritier Wolfgang).

### Infractions Reiksguard tolerance (canon ch.4 l.238-249)
- **Sigmarite party** : Difficult Charm test pour fast talk. 2nd/3rd infraction = harder. 4th expulsé.
- **Neutral party** : 1 chance Very Hard Charm.
- **Ulrican party** : *« expelled with prejudice as soon as caught doing anything suspicious »*.
- Lock picking / rummaging = expulsion immédiate.

## Yeux résidents ch.4 l.272-303

### The Vigilant Eye — [[Kathe Ruttmann]] room
- Bookcases historical+political texts. **Very Hard -30 Perception** find scrap *« Songes de Bertoldt le Malleun »* handout.

### The Fractured Eye — [[Per Haldestaake]] room
- Per sleeps heavily. Bags unpacked Altdorf — notes techniques artisans+professionals.

### The Withering Eye — [[Wilhelmina Novak]] room (vide)
- Left Altdorf. **Wall mural colorful 8 winds magic wheel**.

### The Wandering Eye — [[Wolfie Jessner]] room (vide)
- Left Middenheim 1 mois ago. **Wax seals peeled** + **Hard -20 Perception diary** doubts cultistes fellow tutors.

### The Eagle Eye — [[Ingrid Rademakers]] room
- Sleeps lightly + **rapier defense** Melee (Fencing) 88 + Beat Blade, Distract, Feint, Riposte. Geological samples + animal bones + bestiaries + fencing weapons.

### The Public Eye — [[Wulfrum Ahlquist]] room (vide)
- Altdorf studying. **Scrap Augures Admirables de Tante Augusta** handout (SHEERARGETRU acrostic).

### The Kaleidoscope Eye — [[Gustav Klaus]] room (vide)
- Away. **Dusty**. Orc teeth + Ogre autopsy diagrams + pickled Snotling + Khazalid book. **Karak Skygg mirror shattered 9 pieces under bed** (Arc 6 lien).

### The Hollow Eye — [[Gislind Ursin]] room (vide)
- Left Altdorf weeks ago. **Playwrights folios** : Tarradasch, Sierck, Malvosin, Pikewaver. **Strange Flower von Deihl open** — Difficult -10 Intuition = sympathy Mutants.

### The Far Eye — [[Vatheck Fulci]] room (vide)
- Travelling Border Princes → Altdorf. Old + dusty. Charts + maps distant lands.

## Apparitions par session

### Arc 7 ch.4 S59
- **PJ visite Wolfgang** depuis Shining Rock S58. 5 jours voyage + 1 nuit Altdorf transit.
- **Reiksguard escort** + **assigned guest rooms north wing**.
- **Wolfgang interview** + 3 interruptions canon : Preceptor Leberecht von Hardenburg (Bretonnia alliance), Claudia Karll (Shallya thanks), Hans Bauer (farmer thanks).
- **Kathe Ruttmann arrive post-interview** avec 4 scrolls.
- **PJ peuvent infiltrer Eyes rooms** (option élimination pré-climax).
- **Bannière Carroburg** discreet gift Wolfgang.

### Arc 7 ch.13 climax
- **Wolfgang évacué Reikguard safety post-S61 attentat Barthelm** (canon ch.7 l.7) avant retour Volkshalle ceremony.
